calibration_sources: CNCF KAITO (Kubernetes AI Toolchain Operator) & Azure Artifact Streaming Cold-Start Benchmarks
Run:ai Model Streamer & CoreWeave Tensorizer Concurrent O_DIRECT Safetensors Loading Studies
vLLM Sleep Mode (cuMemUnmap Host-DRAM Staging) & P2P NCCL/RDMA Weight Broadcast Benchmarks

workload.enterprise_scenario: Enterprise AKS / EKS Cluster Serving 70B FP8 LLM (70GB Weights + 18GB CUDA Container Image) Under 4.0x Morning Traffic Surge
workload.target_sla: Pod Scale-Out Time-to-Ready <= 40.0 Seconds, Burst Request Drop Rate <= 0.5%, Idle Over-Provisioned Buffer <= 12%
workload.key_architectural_insights: Never bake 70GB+ model weights into a monolithic Docker image or scale on GPU-Util %; decouple weights onto local NVMe / P2P RDMA broadcast and scale via KEDA on KV cache occupancy.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统 HPA (按 GPU%) + 158GB 胖容器镜像冷拉取 (18 分钟扩容失灵 · 42.5% 请求超时)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Legacy HPA (on GPU-Util %) + 158GB Monolithic Fat Container Image (1,080s Cold Start)
tiers.orchestration_stack: K8s HPA on GPU-Util % + 18GB Runtime & 140GB Weights Baked into Single Gzip OCI Image
tiers.recommended_for: Strict anti-pattern: 158GB gzip decompression + registry bandwidth bottleneck makes autoscaling useless during surges.

tiers.name: Tier 2: KEDA 队列/KV 触发 + 共享 NFS / BlobFuse 挂载权重 (多 Pod 并发读取 IO 拥塞 252 秒)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: KEDA KV-Cache Trigger + Shared NFS / BlobFuse Weight Mount (252s IO Contention)
tiers.orchestration_stack: KEDA on vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc + 18GB Runtime Image + Shared Network NFS/BlobFuse Safetensors
tiers.recommended_for: Small 1–2 pod deployments; bottlenecks when >=4 pods scale out simultaneously and saturate shared NFS throughput.

tiers.name: Tier 3: KAITO / KEDA + P2P 镜像流 + 节点本地 NVMe 缓存 + Run:ai 多线程直传 (38 秒极速就绪)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: KAITO/KEDA + P2P Lazy Image + Node-Local NVMe Cache + Run:ai Streamer (38.0s Ready)
tiers.orchestration_stack: KAITO/KEDA + Artifact Streaming/Dragonfly P2P + Local NVMe RAID0 + Run:ai 32-Thread O_DIRECT Streamer
tiers.recommended_for: Cloud-native AKS/EKS production standard: 28.4x faster scale-out without custom RDMA networking.

tiers.name: Tier 4: KEDA 预测扩容 + Host-DRAM 睡眠热备池 + 跨节点 P2P RDMA 权重广播 (8.5 秒闪电唤醒)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: KEDA Predictive + Host-DRAM Sleep Pool + Peer-to-Peer RDMA Weight Broadcast (8.5s Ready)
tiers.orchestration_stack: vLLM Sleep Mode (Pinned Host DRAM -> PCIe Gen5 HBM in 1.8s) + Peer GPU RDMA Weight Broadcast (8.5s)
tiers.recommended_for: High-elasticity multi-model MaaS clusters requiring sub-10s scale-out and 65.6% lower monthly GPU TCO.
